HED.prologue: testconflict 2.1.0 partners with standard schema 8.5.0. Change from 2.0.0: adds Object-four under Object-tag (minor bump: new tag). Element-compatible with 2.0.0, so the two versions can merge.

node.name: Object-tag
node.description: An ordinary hierarchy of items used for annotations in schema load tests.

node.name: Measure-tag
node.description: A tag that takes a measurement value in load tests.

node.name: Shared-item
node.description: An item identical in every library that shares it.

node.name: Attribute-item
node.description: An item whose suggestedTag value is the controlled difference between libraries.

node.name: Description-item
node.description: An item whose description text is the controlled difference between libraries. This is the testconflict wording.

node.name: Nested-item
node.description: An item whose position in the hierarchy is the controlled difference between libraries.

node.name: Placeholder-item
node.description: An item whose placeholder child presence is the controlled difference between libraries.

node.name: Rooted-tag
node.description: The target subtree of the rooted and shared-hierarchy load cases.

node.name: Rooted-one
node.description: The first child of Rooted-tag, shared across libraries in the hierarchy cases.

node.name: Deep-one
node.description: The grandchild of Rooted-tag through Rooted-one.

node.name: Rooted-two
node.description: The second child of Rooted-tag, specific to testconflict.

HED.epilogue: Part of the hed-tests test schema set. See json_test_data/test_schemas/README.md for the loading convention.
